reply.title: Tamburins Busan: Salt Horizon
reply.subtitle: An ethereal landscape where scent emerges from the silence of salt
reply.line: You traverse a vast, mineral desert where the absence of visual clutter forces you to rely entirely on your sense of smell to navigate the space.
reply.synopsis: As you step onto the pristine salt floor, the world outside fades into the absolute stillness of a blinding white desert. You follow a singular pathway that leads you toward a towering monolith, feeling the crunch of mineral grains beneath your feet. Only as you approach the scattered scent stones do the hidden fragrances reveal themselves, transforming the empty air into a sensory discovery. You conclude your journey at a quiet plaster counter, where the raw materiality of the room leaves you with a lingering, ethereal memory.
reply.quote: True discovery requires the silence of space and the patience of the senses.

The 3.5-meter central monolith acts as a visual anchor that forces you to navigate around it, keeping the rest of the store feeling vast and empty.
The placement of these stones near the path encourages you to stop and lean in, turning a simple walk into an intimate olfactory encounter.
Positioning the minimalist pay counter at the end of the route ensures that your final transaction feels like a natural conclusion to your exploration.
